summary: Automate boring work. Extensible and free desktop AI agent. Discussion | Link
content: Automate any boring task with AgentOne. With over 19,000 built-in extensions, it's easy to integrate nearly any app or website. Connect Gmail, GitHub, Canva, Blender, Chrome, Discord, and more. AgentOne can do work while you do something else. It runs as a desktop app in the background, similar to Claude Cowork. But unlike Claude Cowork, it's free! Plus, you can use any OpenAI-compatible provider (or Claude) to choose from over 8000 AI models.
